prompt: In one statement, build `int[] nums` from the next input line: read the line from `br`, trim it, split it on runs of whitespace using the regex \s+, turn the resulting String array into a stream, map each piece to an int with Integer.parseInt through mapToInt, then convert the IntStream to an int array.
why: Stream variant: split on "\\s+" (any run of whitespace), mapToInt(Integer::parseInt) gives an IntStream, and toArray() makes the int[].
